component.name: SideMenu
component.script:
sub init() m.settingsFocusBg = m.top.findNode("settingsFocusBg") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "onFocusRequested") m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocusChanged") end sub
sub onFocusRequested() m.top.setFocus(true) m.settingsFocusBg.visible = true end sub
sub onFocusChanged() m.settingsFocusBg.visible = m.top.hasFocus() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "right" or key = "back" m.top.closeRequested = true return true end if if key = "OK" m.top.settingsRequested = true return true end if return true end function
